Market today: The market mood is cautious, driven by rising Treasury yields hitting a 19-year high. This directly pressures your tech and chip names, as higher rates make future earnings less valuable and increase borrowing costs.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.93%) and SPAL (-34.04%) are your main concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, deep in the red, and their "SELL" status from the scanner demands immediate attention. Remember, trading on margin amplifies these drawdowns.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields; any further increases will likely continue to weigh on your growth-oriented portfolio. Also, monitor the performance of your leveraged ETFs.

Bottom line: Rising yields are a major headwind; manage your leveraged losers aggressively to protect capital.
plays: SOXL: Your current stop (200) is not protective. Consider setting a new, tighter stop below its current price (146.25) to limit further losses on this leveraged position.
SPAL: Similarly, your stop (21.38) is above its current price (16.59). Set a protective stop below current price to manage risk on this leveraged ETF.
No new buys today - hold and watch. Market headwinds from rising yields suggest caution over initiating new positions.
